name: Sime Darby Property Berhad
overview: Sime Darby Property 今年在柔佛 Kulai 收购约 556.96 英亩永久地契土地（RM418.5 million），并通过持股 50% 的合资公司 JVCo 在柔佛 Mukim Jementah 收购约 1,021.93 英亩土地；同时拟以 RM160.0 million 收购 Wisma UNIRAZAK 办公楼及土地。集团亦完成 Sabah 子公司自愿清盘，并引入 EPF 作为新经济创投基金的有限合伙人。
overview_en: Sime Darby Property acquired approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor for RM418.5 million this year, and through its 50%-owned JVCo, acquired approximately 1,021.93 acres of land in Mukim Jementah, Johor. It also proposed to acquire the Wisma UNIRAZAK office building and land for RM160.0 million. The group completed the voluntary liquidation of its Sabah subsidiary and admitted EPF as a limited partner in its new economy venture fund.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年在柔佛 Kulai 及 Mukim Jementah 收购土地，扩大发展地库。
segments.note_en: Acquired land in Kulai and Mukim Jementah, Johor this year to expand its development land bank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (Kulai) Sdn Bhd 与 SD Guthrie Berhad 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM418.5 million 收购位于柔佛 Kulai、Senai 约 556.96 英亩的两块永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (Kulai) Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with SD Guthrie Berhad to acquire two parcels of freehold land measuring approximately 556.96 acres in Senai, Kulai, Johor for RM418.5 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 持股 50% 的合资公司 Kerayong Development Consortium Sdn Bhd 旗下两家全资子公司签订两份互为条件的买卖协议，收购位于柔佛 Mukim Jementah 约 1,021.93 英亩土地。
actions.text_en: Two wholly-owned subsidiaries of the 50%-owned joint venture Kerayong Development Consortium Sdn Bhd entered into two inter-conditional sale and purchase agreements to acquire approximately 1,021.93 acres of land in Mukim Jementah, Johor.

segments.name: 投资
segments.note: 今年拟收购 Wisma UNIRAZAK 办公楼及土地，扩大投资物业组合。
segments.note_en: Proposed acquisition of the Wisma UNIRAZAK office building and land this year to expand its investment property portfolio.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 买方于 8 月 19 日与 Permodalan Nasional Berhad 就上述 RM160.0 million 收购签订买卖协议。
actions.text_en: The purchaser entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Permodalan Nasional Berhad on 19 August for the above RM160.0 million acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd 于 7 月 6 日接受 Permodalan Nasional Berhad 发出的约束性献议书，拟以 RM160.0 million 收购一栋十五层办公楼（含一层地下停车场）及土地，该办公楼名为 Wisma UNIRAZ…
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd accepted a binding letter of offer from Permodalan Nasional Berhad on 6 July to acquire a fifteen-storey office building with one level of basement carpark known as Wisma UNIRAZAK and its land…

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成 Sabah 子公司清盘，并引入 EPF 作为新经济创投基金的有限合伙人。
segments.note_en: Completed the liquidation of its Sabah subsidiary and admitted EPF as a limited partner in its new economy venture fund this year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd 于 10 月 30 日举行最终会议，完成自愿清盘程序，预计于 2027 年 2 月 4 日解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd held its final meeting on 30 October, completing its members' voluntary liquidation, and is expected to be dissolved on 4 February 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 集团旗下实体于 6 月 9 日签订协议，引入 Employees Provident Fund 作为 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT 及 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT 的有限合伙人。
actions.text_en: Group entities entered into agreements on 9 June to admit the Employees Provident Fund as a limited partner in Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT and Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT 及 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT 引入 EPF 作为有限合伙人，建立新经济创投基金平台。
model_changes.text_en: Admitted EPF as a limited partner in Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT and Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT, establishing a new economy venture fund platform.
